note: Monday B, Japanese light maintenance（日语轻维护）. 事 si6 first, then 12 Hard が/ざ cards — say each aloud before flipping. Recap Thursday's じ and ぜ (the two from that set that were not Hard). Only 5 new: だぢづでど. 写三遍。Watch た/だ, て/で, と/ど; ぢ and づ are rare (usually じ / ず).

tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not rising like 試 si3.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (low, flat, no rise)

tasks.title: NHK hiragana chart · tap the だ行 (dakuten) row
Read without romaji first (only kana you know)

lines.translation: here you go / please · 请 / 给

lines.text: じかん が ない
lines.translation: there is no time · 没有时间 (Thursday recap)

tasks.prompt: Write だぢづでど ×3, saying each aloud (~4 min). Then read the 5 lines twice, slow then normal speed. Watch: た vs だ, て vs で, と vs ど. ぢ and づ are rare — usually write じ and ず.
tasks.script:
da (rare di) (rare du) de do
だれ ですか (dare desu ka)
どこ ですか (doko desu ka)
どうぞ (douzo)
まだ です (mada desu)
じかん が ない (jikan ga nai)

questions.explain: だ = た plus two dots. で is de.
ぢ is rare; almost always write じ. (づ is usually ず.)

questions.q: Write “here you go / please” (douzo) in hiragana.
questions.explain: ど do + う u + ぞ zo.
かぜ = kaze = wind 风. かぎ is key; あじ is taste.
